Identity.//: Development only. LogOtpCodesForDevelopment writes live verification codes to the application log so registration and recovery can be exercised without an SMS provider. IdentityModuleOptionsValidator refuses to start any other environment with it enabled.

Jwt.//: Left empty on purpose. IdentityAuthenticationRegistration falls back to a well-known development key so a fresh clone runs without a secret store; JwtOptionsValidator requires a real key everywhere else.

Realtime.//: Development only. Detailed hub errors are returned to the client so a failing hub call says what went wrong instead of 'an error occurred'; CommunicationRuntimeValidator does not police this one, but the option's own documentation says why nothing deployed should set it.

Presence.//AwayAfterSeconds: Thirty seconds rather than five minutes, so the online/away transition can actually be watched while working on it.

Push.//: Left as None. Switch to 'Loopback' to exercise the configured push path end to end — delivery rows reaching Delivered, analytics moving, endpoint failure counts clearing — without a vendor account. The startup validator refuses Loopback outside Development and Testing, because a deployment that marks every push delivered while no phone lights up is worse than one that admits nothing is configured.
